title: Implement host-neutral external-child wait checkpoint
description: Add the supported host-neutral wait request, serializable child references and terminal results, checkpoint replay behavior, and distinct waiting exception/outcome required by the durable external-child story. Keep host persistence, authorization, polling schedules, and resource resolution outside Tactus. Do not alter process-local Procedure.spawn or add infrastructure.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Coding started: loaded repository and delivery guidance. Will add executable outside-in specs and capture their intended red failure before runtime changes; scope is host-neutral only.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implementation validated: added durable host-neutral external-child wait with request validation, pending checkpoint replay, distinct suspension outcome, all/any terminal semantics, and documentation. Focused unit, BDD, ruff, and black checks are green. No host polling, persistence, scheduling, cancellation, or process-local spawn changes added.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Full local CI on Python 3.11 found 20 existing runtime branch tests failing because the test DummyExecutionContext does not accept the new child_wait_resolver constructor dependency. Direct external-child pytest (15), Behave scenarios, standard-library tests, lint, formatting, wheel build, and import checks pass. A minimal fixture compatibility repair and full-suite rerun are required before acceptance. Two separate SageMaker tests are environment-blocked by missing botocore CRT support and are not attributed to this feature.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Taking the recorded fixture-only follow-up: reproduce the runtime-branch failures, preserve production construction behavior, and validate focused, BDD, and full non-integration tests. No production, dependency, version, or deployment changes.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Fixture compatibility repair is complete and remains limited to the runtime-branch test dummies. Evidence: runtime branches 24 passed; direct external-child tests 15 passed; external-child Behave feature 3 scenarios passed; lint and formatting passed. Full non-integration pytest: 4216 passed, 73 skipped, 63 deselected, with 2 unrelated SageMaker tests blocked by the local AWS login credential provider requiring botocore CRT support. No production, dependency, version, or deployment changes were made. Task remains in_progress pending authorized integration and landing.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Independent review accepted the minimal fixture-only constructor compatibility change with no findings. Focused runtime and external-child tests pass. A full non-integration pytest rerun with inert test AWS credentials now passes 4,218 tests with 73 skipped and 63 deselected in 138 seconds; the prior two SageMaker failures were local login credential-provider setup, not source regressions. Task remains in progress pending commit/release integration.
